historical_session_policy_recommendation.current_schema_constraint: public.class_sessions currently requires lead_instructor_id, location_id, and end_at; true unknown values cannot be persisted directly under the current contract
historical_session_policy_recommendation.duration: allow unknown when source never supplied a defensible duration/end; never synthesize end_at

implementation_review_needed.duration: review nullable end_at for archive-only historical sessions or retain timing as non-authoritative evidence until resolved; never insert a dummy end time
implementation_review_needed.instructor: either use the canonical Unknown Historical Instructor only with explicit missing-evidence/review state and archive-only enforcement, or review nullable lead_instructor_id for historical sessions
implementation_review_needed.location: the current locations table has public but no historical_only/scheduling_status columns; approve an equivalent enforceable archive-only guard before creating any candidate

historical_session_policy_recommendation.instructor: allow unknown when source never supplied it; retain an explicit missing-instructor evidence assertion and review state
historical_session_policy_recommendation.minimum_authority: course_id, location_id or explicit location-unknown state, timezone-aware start_at, durable source session ID, provenance and review status
historical_session_policy_recommendation.operational_boundary: unknown instructor/duration historical sessions must remain archive-only and ineligible for public scheduling, instructor workload, payroll, capacity, or duration analytics
